text:
Ava: Quick update — CryptoSvc (KMS/HSM) sprint 12 SOC2 milestones. Need confirmed owners for auditlog ingestion, rotation playbook, and staging access for fieldwork next Tue. TL;DR: blockers and asks below.

Ben: I'll own auditlog ingestion (Ben). Targeting PR + smoke by Fri.

Carla: I can take the rotation playbook draft. Who should be on review? @Ben for log format, @Sam for deployment/runbook ops.

Sam: deploy-bot: staging/cryptosvc v1.3.2 deployed :rocket: (automated)

Diego: Question — auditors will need read-only access to staging KMS logs. What's the official request flow? I thought we need a ticket + justification.

Ava: File the request in #help using the "auditor-staging-access" template. Include reason, time window, and the evidence IDs you expect them to need.

Ben: PR 4125 adds audit forwarder to S3 (encrypted). Smoke logs look good. Link: https://git/repo/pull/4125

Carla: Rotation doc draft is in the docs folder (short link). Will ping for reviews by EOW.

Diego: For HSM attestation — do we already have a vendor slot reserved? Need to confirm before fieldwork. @Ava can you follow up with vendor liaison?

Ava: Yep — vendor liaison engaged. I'll set a 30m tabletop for Mon 10am PT and add it to the calendar.

Sam: Can we get the key rotation cron into Console once playbook is approved? Proposed cron: `0 2 * * SUN`. I can apply post-approval.

Ben: Approved. Also please add explicit rollback steps in the runbook.

Carla: Will add rollback steps and the evidence ID format. Proposal for evidence IDs: `EVID-CRYPTO-<YYYYMMDD>-<seq>`

Ava: Action items recap: 1) Ben — finalize PR (audit forwarder) by Fri. 2) Carla — rotation doc + rollback + evidence format by EOW. 3) Sam — staging access flow doc + apply cron after approvals. 4) Diego — confirm vendor attestation slot and SLA. Ping me if blocked.

Diego: Noted, will confirm vendor tomorrow and post update here.

Sam: FYI I kicked a staging redeploy to pick up PR changes: `deploy staging cryptosvc v1.3.3`

Ben: Smoke snippet: ```
2024-11-03T12:02:33Z INFO audit.forwarded key=kms/123
```

Carla: Quick ask — does anyone have a sample HSM attestation statement (template) we can reuse?

Diego: Vendor said they'll send the template to me; I'll drop it here once received.

Ava: Thanks everyone — will follow up with calendar invite and add the attest template to the docs dir when Diego posts it. :thumbsup:
